title: THE ATLAS WORLD
subtitle: Bellfaith survey where the towers see; mariners' report beyond
hand: This is a compiled chart, not a single hand's survey. The basin ground is the Bellfaith's own work, walked, sounded, and towered. Every coast beyond it is set down from masters' logs sworn at Gildmark harbour, not from any keel of ours. A hatched coast is reported, never vouched.
